vault_not_forwarded./etapi/: unauthenticated once Trilium's own login is off
vault_not_forwarded./mcp: ETAPI-token only, and a name awm wants
vault_not_forwarded./share/: public by design upstream; meaningless behind the session
vault_not_forwarded./logout: claimed by the edge, so it ends the awm session

slices_not_forwarded./manifest.webmanifest: the vault synthesizes its own; a slice installs as nothing
slices_not_forwarded./robots.txt: a link handed to one person is not a site to crawl

tether_not_forwarded./health: a liveness probe for whatever supervises the process, over loopback
tether_not_forwarded./issue: mints a slot behind the bearer, which never leaves the relay's host
tether_not_forwarded./status: the operator's report, behind the same bearer
tether_not_forwarded./room: opens a room behind the same bearer
